measure: SEC-as-reported annual gross profit divided by consolidated assets; adaptation, not Compustat replication

JNJ.reason: FY2020 ends 2021-01-03; June2021 remains outside the prior-calendar-year rule

PG.reason: Reported production cost includes manufacturing, distribution, warehousing and shipping; preserve as-filed pension reclassification vintages

COST.reason: Issuer-reported gross margin adaptation: net sales less merchandise costs, excluding membership. Distribution/fulfillment/manufacturing and selected depreciation included, but warehouse staff and substantially all building/equipment depreciation in SG&A; not Compustat comparability. 2018 onward direct GP only: net-sales/membership observations use product/member dimensions, excluded by this whole-entity reader; no reviewed dimension-to-total derivation. Nonfinancial FY2016 amendment lacks a structured instance and remains blocked by bounded review support.

AMZN.reason: Tagged cost of sales excludes fulfillment and important AWS infrastructure costs; no invented allocation

WMT.reason: Total revenues includes membership/other income; distribution warehousing and occupancy in SG&A limit whole-company complete-cost comparability

CAT.reason: Industrial cost of sales cannot match consolidated financial-plus-industrial revenue/assets; generic cost tags also include minor expense items

UNP.reason: No reviewed annual gross-profit mapping; operating income is not a substitute

MCD.reason: Franchise/company-operated scopes require separate accounting review

GOOGL.reason: Outside common strategy panel; multi-class market equity unresolved

UPS.reason: Outside common strategy panel; multi-class market equity unresolved

preferred_policy: Redemption, then liquidation, then par; exact annual issuer/date scope. Missing tags never imply zero.
share_policy: Exact December31 issuer outstanding shares, GAAP or explicitly dated DEI; original components alone do not qualify split/class basis. No nearest-quarter substitution.
